metadata.source: MIT Open Data / AINOP - Elenco opere pubbliche censite su portale AINOP
metadata.caveat: AINOP is a census fed by infrastructure owners/managers; counts are treated as a denominator candidate, not a complete inventory guarantee.
metadata.formula: provincial_rate = ARCUS cases in province / AINOP bridges counted in province * 100; relative_to_national = provincial_rate / national_rate
metadata.confidence_method: Confidence is based on AINOP denominator availability/size by province: high >=300 bridges, medium 100-299, low 25-99, very_low 1-24, unavailable 0. This is a methodological confidence on the denominator, not a validation of structural risk.
metadata.indices_policy: Priority Index and Collapse Rate are separate layers: Priority Index measures territorial exposure; Collapse Rate measures documented ARCUS collapses relative to AINOP bridge denominator.
